items.title: LR-printer
items.summary: Converting integers to strings from the left, without a remainder operation or a final reversal By Tigran Hayrapetyan Project page: https://towardsdatascience.com/lr-printer/ ShipAI is a Towards Data Science project. Watch all the videos here: https://towardsdatascience.com/videos/ Key takeaways. 1. The standard algorithm needs a remainder and a division per digit, both four to five times slower than addition. 2. LR Printer divides by precomputed powers of the base and subtracts, so digits come out left to right, unreversed. 3. On a newer compiler, 64-bit integers took 2.4 seconds against 4.4 for the standard method, beating the article's 34%.
